primary_statistic: joint ordering of all adjacent measured-size LER differences

bootstrap.unit: complete nested-p seed trajectory, independently resampled by distance

classification_rule.decodable: observed LER strictly decreases at every adjacent size and joint bootstrap support >= 0.90
classification_rule.undecodable: observed LER strictly increases at every adjacent size and joint bootstrap support >= 0.90
classification_rule.unresolved: otherwise, including nonmonotone and plateau behavior

evidence_boundary: Finite-window direction over measured L=7,9,11 only; not an asymptotic phase proof or scaling-law fit.
